extracted.intended_audience: artists, writers, poets, and thinkers seeking prescriptive guidance on the moral and aesthetic role of art
extracted.subtask_description: Prescriptive guidance for artists on how to create work that preserves human dignity, educates sensibility, and exerts long-term moral influence rather than merely following contemporary fashions or short-term success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Educate the sensibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The most pressing need of the present time is to educate the sensibility, because it is the means not only to render efficacious in practice the improvement of ideas, but to call this improvement into existence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize development of feeling and heart alongside intellectual clarity. Anti-pattern: relying on understanding alone without cultivating receptivity in audiences; consequence is that philosophical truths fail to effect character.

rubrics_metrics.name: Art as preserver of dignity and truth
rubrics_metrics.description: Humanity has lost its dignity, but art has saved it, and preserves it in marbles full of meaning; truth continues to live in illusion, and the copy will serve to re-establish the model.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim to create works that keep alive noble ideals beyond corrupt contemporary contexts. Example: classical statues retaining sanctity long after political degradation. Scoring note: evaluate works by their capacity to embody and preserve higher forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence from the age
rubrics_metrics.description: Live with your age, but be not its creation; the artist is the child of his time, but unhappy for him if he is its disciple or even its favorite.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not subordinate form or content to fashionable trends or the appetites of the moment. Anti-pattern: being a 'disciple' of the age leads to producing work that merely reflects corruption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aim for the ideal — form from a nobler time
rubrics_metrics.description: He will receive his matter from the present time, but he will borrow the form from a nobler time and even beyond all time, from the essential, absolute, immutable unity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seek timeless forms and unifying principles as the formal basis of work even when material is contemporary. Evaluate whether form lifts matter toward universality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize dignity and law over necessity and fortune
rubrics_metrics.description: Let him raise his eyes to his own dignity, and to law; let him not lower them to necessity and fortune.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resist producing for immediate profit or popularity; prefer integrity and adherence to higher laws of art. Anti-pattern: pandering to necessity/fortune compromises artistic dignity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Give birth to the ideal by uniting the possible and the necessary
rubrics_metrics.description: Let the artist endeavor to give birth to the ideal by the union of the possible and of the necessary. Let him stamp illusion and truth with the effigy of this ideal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compose work that balances imaginative illusion with essential truth — the ideal should be plausible yet necessary. Evaluate whether a piece successfully fuses verisimilitude and moral/ontological necessity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make truth incarnate through beauty
rubrics_metrics.description: Cherish triumphant truth in the modest sanctuary of your heart; give it an incarnate form through beauty, that it may not only be in the understanding that does homage to it, but that feeling may lovingly grasp its appearance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use aesthetic form to render abstract truth emotionally graspable. Anti-pattern: abstract truths presented without aesthetic embodiment fail to move feeling and thus fail to effect change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aim for timelessness — 'launch work into infinite time'
rubrics_metrics.description: Let him quietly launch his work into infinite time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value endurance and long-term influence over immediate acclaim. Judge works by their potential to remain meaningful across generations rather than by ephemeral popularity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practice creative patience and disciplined craft
rubrics_metrics.description: This divine instinct, and creative force, much too ardent to follow this peaceful walk, often throws itself immediately on the present... the creative force requires that great and patient temper which is required to impress the ideal on the dumb marble, or to spread it over a page of cold, sober letters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Favor slow, disciplined work that tempers enthusiasm with craft. Anti-pattern: impulsive activism or rushed production that sacrifices form and depth for immediate action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Test motives before direct political action
rubrics_metrics.description: Has this innovator examined himself to see if these disorders of the moral world wound his reason, or if they do not rather wound his self-love? If he does not determine this point at once, he will find it from the impulsiveness with which he pursues a prompt and definite end.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before engaging in agitational intervention, ensure motives are moral rather than egoistic. Evaluate whether activism is grounded in selfless commitment to the ideal or in personal vanity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct the world by education and exemplification rather than coercion
rubrics_metrics.description: Direct the world on which you act towards that which is good... if by your teaching you raise its thoughts towards the necessary and the eternal; if, by your acts or your creations, you make the necessary and the eternal the object of your leanings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer influencing public taste, teaching, and creating exemplars that gradually change hearts and minds. Measure success by shifts in taste and feelings rather than by legislative or coercive outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engage contemporaries by serving their needs, not their praise
rubrics_metrics.description: Live with your age, but be not its creation; labor for your contemporaries, but do for them what they need, and not what they praise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tailor work to genuinely elevate or serve the public rather than to flatter their current preferences. Anti-pattern: creating for applause undermines transformative potential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mould leisure and taste to effect moral change
rubrics_metrics.description: Drive away caprice, frivolity, and coarseness from their pleasures, and you will banish them imperceptibly from their acts, and at length from their feelings. Everywhere that you meet them, surround them with great, noble, and ingenious forms; multiply around them the symbols of perfection, till appearance triumphs over reality, and art over nature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work to reform public taste through the objects and experiences that populate people's leisure — use beauty in popular spheres to cultivate better feeling and conduct over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guard against the misuse of beauty
rubrics_metrics.description: The charms of the beautiful can further honorable ends in pure hands; but it is not repugnant to its nature to produce, in impure hands, a directly contrary effect... taste only attends to the form and never to the substance; it ends by placing the soul on the dangerous incline, leading it to neglect all reality and to sacrifice truth and morality to an attractive envelope.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure substance and morality underpin beauty; avoid producing art that glorifies appearance at the expense of truth. Anti-pattern: aestheticism that masks vice or promotes complacency; historical examples cited (art flourishing coinciding with political decline).

rubrics_metrics.name: Balance specialization with harmonious human development
rubrics_metrics.description: It is only the well-tempered equilibrium of these forces that can produce happy and accomplished men... the tension of the isolated spiritual forces may make extraordinary men; but it is only the well-tempered equilibrium of these forces that can produce happy and accomplished men.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When creating characters, themes, or artistic practices, strive for integration of faculties (imagination, feeling, intellect) rather than glorifying one at the cost of others. Evaluate works by how they promote a balanced humanity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be prepared to endure misunderstanding and remain constant
rubrics_metrics.description: Without having shared their faults, share their punishment with a noble resignation, and bend under the yoke which they find it as painful to dispense with as to bear... By the constancy with which you will despise their good fortune, you will prove to them that it is not through cowardice that you submit to their sufferings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accept that transformative art may be resisted; maintain steady commitment to principles. Assess artistic integrity by willingness to endure social neglect or hostility for higher aims.
